result.title: OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning
result.summary: Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OACap，一个以 caption 为中心的视频 agent：把缺失或缺乏支撑的信息转成针对性观察请求，用时空工具取证并迭代验证修订描述；同时构建 FSCap-Bench，以主张精确度加重要性加权事实覆盖（CSFS）和跨模态语义往返（CSRS）诊断描述保留的信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「决定获取何种证据—取证—验证并停止」的观察循环与 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本和视觉证据筛选直接相关，FSCap-Bench 对信息保留的诊断也可供核查「信息坍缩」类问题；但状态为显式 caption 而非 latent，向 LVR 的迁移需阅读原文确认。
